concept.title: Booking, membership or contact first
concept.shortdesc: Services that must be accessed by joining as a member, booking, making an appointment or getting in touch before attending.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Services open only to one gender, such as women-only or men-only, or to people linked to existing members or a centre's other services.
: Conditions that limit when or for how long a person can use a service, such as term-time-only sessions, fixed stay lengths, or having to attend at set intervals.
: Phrases saying what a person does not need in order to join, such as a referral, diagnosis or membership, along with related notes on prior experience or beginner level.
: Services or sessions that can only be used by making an appointment, or where an appointment is the way in.
: Services open only to members, or where joining a club, group or library is needed in order to use them.
: People must get in touch with the service, by phone, email or form, before they come, for example to check eligibility, discuss needs or confirm a date.
: A place or session must be booked before attending, by phone, email or an online system.
: Phrases that say the service, appointment or journey must be booked ahead of time, sometimes with a minimum notice period.
: Conditions about a person's home life or ability to get out, such as living alone, being housebound, being unable to travel or use universal services.
